name: David Adegbola
title: Forest bioeconomy, GIS and remote sensing
intro: Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy student at the University of Eastern Finland in Joensuu, looking for trainee, summer and field work in forestry, GIS and remote sensing in Finland.
description: David Adegbola: Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy student at UEF, working towards GIS, remote sensing and forestry roles in Finland.
about: I grew up in Nigeria and came to Finland to study IT at VAMK in Vaasa. Working as a fitter at the UPM Kaukas pulp mill in 2025 changed my direction. Watching logs float on Lake Saimaa beside the mill, I started asking where they came from and how the forests behind them are managed. That question took me to Sustainable Forest Bioeconomy at UEF. Now I'm learning GIS and remote sensing: reading forests from data, and checking what that data means on the ground.
skills: Soil sampling and site description (field course)
User research: interviews and calls to companies
Building tools with AI coding agents (Claude Code)
Learning: GIS, forest measurement, brush saw, chainsaw
